name: Daniel Attard - Proposition de résolution
title: REPORT on enhancing connectivity, preserving cultural heritage, and driving local excellence in European tourism: destination management and regional tourism growth
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its ideas for making tourism work better for residents, visitors and the environment. It asks for better transport links to remote, rural and island areas, and for rules to limit the damage caused by too many visitors and short-term holiday rentals. It also wants fair pay and training for tourism workers, protection of local culture and heritage, and a dedicated budget for tourism in the next long-term EU budget.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is only stating its position and asking the European Commission to act.
- **Who it affects:** Tourists, residents of busy destinations, tourism workers and small businesses.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to propose laws or funding, including in the next long-term EU budget.
